items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: The Mongols -- when Genghis Khan and his crowd took over, and there's many of them in there.

ctx.x: But, on the whole, we had a wonderful time. And that was when we went to the Winter Palace in Leningrad. It was Leningrad, then, it was old St. Petersburg. And one thing, I was glad -- a lot of the boys had got in all kinds of fights up there with their family. Those that took their wives. You see, because, at 11 o'clock at night in Petersburg or Leningrad, it's daylight. You can read the newspaper. In the summertime, because that was around the summertime when we got there. And so, we used to, at 11 'o'clock, at…

"Here it's daybreak and you're just coming home." Well it was only eleven o'clock. They thought we were around having a wonderful time. We did have a wonderful time. The Russian people are like the black people. They have a lot of emotion. They are a really emotional people. And the greatest song that I ever heard -- the greatest singing that I ever heard, outside of black people was the Russian choir on Easter. The Bolsheviks or the Soviets, as now, had cut that out. But nobody had stopped the churches. And we…
